description: Defines domain layer models for a TV media catalog, including enumerations and data classes for media types, media items, and media categories. The models are designed to be immutable and suitable for UI and repository mapping.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Represents a content entity with various media-related properties including IDs, titles, images, URLs, and type indicators.

classes.name: MediaCategory
classes.description: Represents a row of media items with a stable ID, title, and list of MediaItem objects.

methods.name: MediaType
methods.description: An enum class defining media types: MOVIE, SERIES, and LIVE.
